newsitem.title: CHINA: Section of China JV railway to open next week.
newsitem.headline: Section of China JV railway to open next week.

text.p: A section of a 1.9 billion yuan ($229 million) joint venture railway in China's eastern province of Zhejiang is to open soon, the China Daily said on Friday.
The section from Jinyun to Lishui would open to traffic next week, the newspaper said.
Work on the 251.5-km (156.3-mile) line from Jinhua to Wenzhou was started in 1992 by Hong Kong's Lin Ying Co, the Zhejiang Provincial Railway Corp and China's Ministry of Railway, it said.

Lin Ying held a 25 percent stake in the project while the ministry had 30 percent and the Zhejiang Provincial Railway 40 percent, the newspaper said. It did not say who held the remaining five percent.
Work on the entire line was nearly complete, with the remaining 20 percent scheduled to be finished by the end of 1996, it said.
